name: Fund Brief
description: One-screen LP summary: manager, terms, track record, and the flags an IC will ask about

columns.label: Fund snapshot
columns.prompt:
Create a FUND SNAPSHOT from the pitchbook, PPM, and DDQ. Use this exact field format, one field per line, and write "Not found" when the documents do not support a field:
Manager: [GP firm]
Fund: [fund name and number]
Vintage: [year]
Strategy: [strategy, sector, geography focus]
Target size: [target fund size]
Hard cap: [hard cap if disclosed]
Geography: [operating footprint]
Raise stage: [first close / interim / final close / open]. Include [Source N] citations for the most important fields.

columns.label: Terms at a glance
columns.prompt:
Extract the FUND TERMS from the PPM and LPA. Use this exact field format, one field per line, and write "Not found" when unsupported:
Management fee: [rate and basis, with any step-down]
Carried interest: [percent]
Preferred return: [hurdle]
Waterfall: [European/whole-fund or American/deal-by-deal]
GP commitment: [percent]
Fee offset: [percent of transaction/monitoring fees offset]
Key person: [named key persons and the trigger]
Term: [fund term and extensions]. Include [Source N] citations.

columns.label: Key performance data
columns.prompt: Extract the manager's TRACK RECORD into a markdown table titled "Track Record" with columns: Fund, Vintage, Fund Size, Net IRR, TVPI, DPI, RVPI. Add one row per prior fund from the track record, pitchbook, or PPM. Immediately after the table, add a short "Reconciliation" note that checks each fund for DPI + RVPI = TVPI and names any fund where they do not tie (a common presentation red flag). Include [Source N] citations in the row labels or note. Write "Not found" in cells the documents do not support; do not invent figures.

columns.label: Investment thesis
columns.prompt:
Synthesize the LP INVESTMENT CASE for backing this manager, grounded only in the documents. Use these exact section headings on their own lines, each followed by 3–5 short bullets starting with "- ", one sentence each, with [Source N] citations where supported:
Thesis: [why back this manager and fund now — edge, market position, consistency]
Value creation levers: [how the GP drives returns — operational playbook, buy-and-build, pricing, sector angle]
Exit considerations: [realization outlook and liquidity — DPI trajectory, exit environment, duration]
Risks to thesis: [key risks — succession, size creep, concentration, cyclicality, terms]
If a section has no support, write a single "- Not found" bullet under it. Do not invent claims.

columns.label: Analyst next actions
columns.prompt: Propose the top 5 NEXT DILIGENCE ACTIONS for the LP analyst: documents to request, numbers to reconcile, references to call, terms to negotiate, and ODD items to close. Each action is one sentence; cite the source or gap that motivated it with [Source N] where possible.

columns.label: Track record red flags
columns.prompt: Scan the track record and performance materials for RED FLAGS: TVPI that does not equal DPI + RVPI, cherry-picked or partial fund subsets, gross-versus-net presentation gaps, recycled capital inflating multiples, missing or excluded funds, and unrealized marks carrying the headline. List each with its severity and a [Source N] citation.

columns.label: Off-market or LP-unfavorable terms
columns.prompt: Identify FUND TERMS that are OFF-MARKET or LP-UNFAVORABLE versus ILPA norms: fee offsets below 100%, no-fault removal thresholds above a simple majority, low GP commitment, high organizational-expense caps, deal-by-deal carry without a clawback escrow, aggressive recycling, and weak key-person or LPAC provisions. List each with the specific term and a [Source N] citation.

columns.label: Team & key-person risks
columns.prompt: Scan for TEAM AND KEY-PERSON RISKS: partner departures (including cases where one document still lists a departed person as active while another discloses the departure), succession gaps, thin bench, and whether named key persons remain active. List each with a [Source N] citation.

columns.label: Operational & compliance exposure
columns.prompt: Scan the Form ADV, ODD materials, valuation policy, and audited financials for OPERATIONAL AND COMPLIANCE EXPOSURE: regulatory disclosures or deficiency letters, affiliated service providers or brokers receiving fees, valuation-governance gaps (GP self-marking Level 3 with only infrequent third-party review), and cybersecurity or business-continuity weaknesses. List each with a [Source N] citation.

columns.label: Data room gaps & omissions
columns.prompt: Identify what is CONSPICUOUSLY ABSENT for LP diligence: missing DDQ sections, no audited financials, no valuation policy, unprovided references, or unanswered questions the materials raise. List each gap and why it matters.

columns.label: Cross-document inconsistencies
columns.prompt: Cross-reference the DDQ, PPM, LPA, pitchbook, and track record. Identify CONTRADICTIONS: fees or terms described differently across documents, performance figures that do not match, team or headcount claims that conflict, and any narrative in one document undermined by another. List each inconsistency with the conflicting sources and [Source N] citations.

name: Track Record Grid
description: Fund-level performance extraction with TVPI reconciliation

columns.label: Fund name
columns.prompt: Extract the FUND NAME. Include a [Source N] citation; write "Not found" if unsupported.

columns.label: Vintage
columns.prompt: Extract the VINTAGE YEAR, e.g. 2018. Include a [Source N] citation; write "Not found" if unsupported.

columns.label: Fund size
columns.prompt: Extract total FUND SIZE with currency. Include a [Source N] citation; write "Not found" if unsupported.

columns.label: Net IRR
columns.prompt: Extract NET IRR only, not gross IRR. Include a [Source N] citation; write "Not found" if unsupported.

columns.label: TVPI
columns.prompt: Extract TVPI. Return the numeric multiple only, e.g. 1.85. Include a [Source N] citation; write "Not found" if unsupported.

columns.label: DPI
columns.prompt: Extract DPI. Return the numeric multiple only, e.g. 1.85. Include a [Source N] citation; write "Not found" if unsupported.

columns.label: RVPI
columns.prompt: Extract RVPI. Return the numeric multiple only, e.g. 1.85. Include a [Source N] citation; write "Not found" if unsupported.

columns.label: Loss ratio
columns.prompt: Extract or calculate the LOSS RATIO: percent of invested capital in deals returning below 1.0x. Include [Source N] citations; write "Not found" if unsupported.

columns.label: Realized vs unrealized
columns.prompt:
Summarize the REALIZED VS UNREALIZED performance mix. Use exactly: Realized: [desc]
Unrealized: [desc]. Include [Source N] citations; write "Not found" if unsupported.

columns.label: Restatement & footnote flags
columns.prompt: Flag RESTATEMENTS AND FOOTNOTE RISKS: recycled capital, gross-vs-net presentation, cherry-picked subsets, and missing funds. Include [Source N] citations; write "Not found" if none are supported.

columns.label: Reconciliation
columns.prompt: Derived check of whether TVPI equals DPI plus RVPI.

List SERVICE PROVIDERS using exactly: Auditor: [desc]
Administrator: [desc]
Custodian: [desc]

columns.label: Financial health of the GP

columns.label: Overall ODD rating
columns.prompt: Rate OVERALL ODD. Return a single token from {Clean, Monitor, Red flag}, followed by one sentence of justification and the top supporting [Source N] citations.

name: Fund Commitment Memo
description: Four-stage LP underwriting workflow from manager assessment to recommendation

stages.label: Manager & Strategy Assessment
stages.prompt_md: Assess the MANAGER AND STRATEGY from the pitchbook, DDQ, and PPM: firm history and ownership, team depth and succession, strategy and edge, fund size versus the prior fund with a size-creep check, and market environment. Cite every claim as [filename p.N]; write "Not found" for unsupported topics.

stages.label: Track Record & Terms Diagnostic
stages.prompt_md: Diagnose TRACK RECORD AND TERMS: performance by fund (IRR, TVPI, DPI), dispersion and loss ratio, realized versus unrealized mix, a DPI-versus-IRR quality note, and terms versus ILPA norms. Cite every claim as [filename p.N]. Insert explicit [BENCHMARK — fill in] placeholders wherever peer data is required.

stages.label: ODD & Risk Summary
stages.prompt_md: Summarize ODD AND UNDERWRITING RISK: operational findings, open diligence items, reference-call gaps, and side-letter asks to negotiate. Cite every claim as [filename p.N]; write "Not found" when evidence is absent.

stages.label: Compose Commitment Memo
stages.prompt_md: Using the analyst-edited outputs of Stages 1–3 as authoritative, compose the FUND COMMITMENT MEMO with: Executive Summary; Organization; Strategy; Track Record; Fund Terms; Operational Assessment; Risks & Mitigants; Recommendation. State the proposed commitment or use [COMMITMENT AMOUNT]. Preserve all citations and do not overwrite analyst judgments.
